newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda recruits more troops to cope with rebels.
newsitem.headline: Uganda recruits more troops to cope with rebels.

text.p: Uganda's army has launched a drive to recruit 750 soldiers and local militia to counter rebels who recently invaded western Uganda from the neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo, the independent Monitor reported on Sunday.

The newspaper quoted the army's western operations commander as saying retired soldiers would be recruited to reinforce in the area and young men would be enlisted in local militia units to defend border areas.
Defence officials say they have broken up the rebel units which invaded parts of western Uganda in June, but vigilance is needed against incursions.
Uganda says the Allied Democratic Forces rebels are supported by the Sudanese government, a charge denied by Sudan.
